title: SSH compromise with persistence
summary: Assessment: likely SSH compromise with persistence via backdoor account.
recommendation: Disable deploy and sysupdate accounts. Block 185.220.101.7 at the firewall. Rotate all credentials. Audit root command history.

story.text: IP 185.220.101.7 made 214 failed SSH logins against 3 accounts in 38 minutes (Credential Access, T1110.001).
IP 185.220.101.7 successfully logged in as deploy after prior failures – the first login for this account from this IP and outside its normal 09:00–18:00 hours (Initial Access, T1078).
User deploy ran sudo as root within 2 minutes of suspicious login (Privilege Escalation, T1548.003).
A new account was created: sysupdate (Persistence, T1136.001 – local account creation).
